label: Future Hazard
description: Projected change in climate hazard by mid- and late century (SSP2-4.5), from six individual INDRA-CMIP6 models, following Rama Rao et al. (2020).

label: Historical Hazard
description: How often districts have faced drought, floods and cyclones in the past, following Rama Rao et al. (2020): drought 55%, flood 25%, cyclone 20%.

label: Exposure
description: Inventory of rural people and agriculture-dependent livelihoods that could be adversely affected by climate change impacts.

label: Vulnerability
description: How well districts can absorb and adapt to climate shocks: natural, human, social, physical and financial capital (Rama Rao et al. 2020). 14 of the 15 Atlas indicators.

label: Risk Score
description: Where is farming most at risk from climate change? The Rama Rao et al. (2020) index combines historical and future hazard, exposure and vulnerability with the Atlas weights.
